text: うーん…　たしか　みずは　でんきを　よく　とおす　から　わざが　きく　はず　だよね…

structure.jp: みずは　でんきを　よく　とおす　から
わざが　きく　はず　だよね…

patterns.name: 〜はずだ
patterns.explanation: はずだ after a verb says you expect it to be so, from what you know. きく　はず　だ = 'it should work'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives the reason for what comes next, like 'so'. とおす　から = 'it conducts, so'.

patterns.name: 〜よね
patterns.explanation: よね at the end says you think so and want the listener to agree. だよね = 'that's right, isn't it?'.
